body: openProject({cache:true}) caches parsed records per folder, revalidated on every read by file name/size/mtime (stat is far cheaper than read+parse); only cached when the stamp is unchanged across the load; deep-frozen records. Enabled in pman serve. 6,063 tickets: tree 0.45→0.13 s, search ~1→0.11 s, plan 1.3→0.33 s. Full test suite also passes with the cache forced on.
